dimensions.assessment: Applies to Department of Homeland Security personnel, training program administrators, and state, local, tribal, and territorial law enforcement agencies.
dimensions.evidence: enhance access to training offered by the Federal Law Enforcement Training Centers to State, local, Tribal, and territorial law enforcement

dimensions.assessment: Establishes administrative reporting requirements for training accreditation lapses and status updates.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Homeland Security shall report to the relevant congressional committees on the accreditation status for each basic training program

dimensions.assessment: Does not explicitly state new spending amounts or authorizations for the reporting and research directives.
Mandates new annual reporting obligations, notification procedures for accreditation lapses, and research and development initiatives.
dimensions.evidence: If a basic training program of the Department of Homeland Security loses accreditation, the head of the relevant component... shall notify the Secretary

dimensions.assessment: Requires annual reporting that continues until all applicable basic training programs are accredited.
dimensions.evidence: Annual reports under paragraph (1) shall terminate when all basic training programs of the Department of Homeland Security referred to in such paragraph are accredited.

importance_detail.rationale: Requires annual reporting on the accreditation status of Department of Homeland Security basic training programs and mandates DHS research and technology development for training access.
